name: Lilak Persian spell-checking dictionary 3.3
note: Apache-2.0 outright, which makes it the cleanest licence of any source in the corpus
— nothing to reconcile, no attribution table entry needed beyond the notice.
Persian was blocked twice over: the Open Multilingual Wordnet has no Persian member,
and the alternatives are research-only. This closes it.
A hunspell spell-checking dictionary, so it is a flat word list with affix flags and
carries no part-of-speech tags. It therefore fills `lorem.word` and cannot fill
`word.noun` or `word.verb` — labelling unclassified words as nouns would be a quiet
untruth of exactly the kind this pipeline exists to prevent.
Pinned to a GitHub *release asset*, which is immutable, unlike the auto-generated
source tarballs that made OpenTaal's Dutch dictionary unusable here.
